profile_text.body:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a public company headquartered in Seattle, WA, operating as a subsidiary of Amazon (ticker: AMZN, CIK 0001018724), which was founded in 1994. AWS's most recent annual revenue, reported on a 10-K for the period ending 2025-12-31, was $716,924,000,000. The company's website for its AI and machine learning offerings centers on Amazon SageMaker, which it describes as a unified environment for data, analytics, and AI development.

Amazon SageMaker is positioned as a full machine learning lifecycle platform covering model development, training, deployment, governance, and observability. The site describes SageMaker Unified Studio as an integrated development environment that brings together tools for model development, generative AI, data processing, and SQL analytics, with access to data stored in Amazon S3 data lakes, Amazon Redshift data warehouses, and third-party or federated sources via a lakehouse architecture built on Apache Iceberg. Supporting tools mentioned include HyperPod, JumpStart, MLOps capabilities, and Amazon Q Developer, described on the site as a generative AI assistant for software development tasks including data discovery, model building, SQL query generation, and data pipeline creation. AWS also tracks AWS Bedrock as a separate product, a managed foundation model API service that includes IAM integration, VPC support, model evaluation tools, and an AgentCore component for agent orchestration.

The held facts note 52 legal exposure records associated with Washington state, though no specific cases are detailed in the available data. AWS has no MCP server presence recorded in the registry.
